rows.grounds: fused compound indicating a depression equal to one barleycorn; analyzed as given without splitting
denotes the inscribed lines whose depth is specified
vocative address to the recipient of instruction

items.question: What prescribed depth must the inscribed ritual lines have?
premises: The instruction concerns the depth of the inscribed lines.
The specified depression measures one barleycorn.
The prescription is addressed to the best of the twice-born.
items.inference: The inscribed lines must be made with a depression equal to one barleycorn.
uncertainties: The internal segmentation of yavākaikartunimnaṃ is uncertain, though its sense as one-barleycorn depth is clear from context.
items.plain_english: O best of the twice-born, the lines should indeed be depressed to the depth of one barleycorn.
